query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 764 AND 768),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('opec-opec-plus-boundary-764','apec-gecf-ttip-mint-n11-boundary-765','international-organizations-exam-boundary-766','international-organizations-exam-boundary-767','international-organizations-exam-boundary-768')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 764 AND 768),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 764 AND 768),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 764 AND 768),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 764 AND 768),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 764 AND 768),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0764-0768:%'),'search_documents',0) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
